Oscar T: Heads-up: platform will accept a new canonical routing header next week: X-Routing-Strategy. Values: `balanced` and `fast`. They also want a tiny quota attribution header X-Quota-Label so console can attribute cost. SDKs should normalize casing and accept legacy names `route_strategy` and `routeStrategy` as fallbacks. cc @Maya R

Maya R: DevEx preference is opt-in for public releases. We should provide a helper that follows precedence: explicit param > X-Routing-Strategy > legacy keys. Console UX: surface an "Effective strategy" column in request samples so teams can validate remaps.

Leo (platform): Server plan: keep current routing unchanged by default and accept legacy keys for 100 days. We'll emit sampled telemetry `routing.policy_mismatch` when legacy/new conflict and a low-rate `routing.legacy_seen` metric. SDKs: please emit `sdk.routing_policy_override` when the client remaps headers.

ci-bot: routing-api compat canary scheduled -> 2026-04-02 03:15 UTC (https://deploys.redwood.internal/routing-api/compat-canary) :rocket:

Oscar T: For Go/TS we prefer a builder option `WithRoutingStrategy(...)` and env `REDWOOD_ROUTE_POLICY_BEHAVIOR=off|opt-in|mirror`. DevEx: default off for GA. For internal canary we can enable `mirror`.

Maya R: Example Python helper for RFC (to include in migration docs):
```python
def normalize_strategy(headers, explicit=None):
    # precedence: explicit param > canonical header > legacy keys
    if explicit:
        headers['X-Routing-Strategy'] = explicit
    else:
        for k in ('X-Routing-Strategy','x-routing-strategy','route_strategy','routeStrategy'):
            if k in headers:
                headers['X-Routing-Strategy'] = headers[k]
                break
    headers['X-Quota-Label'] = headers.get('X-Quota-Label', 'sdk:py:unversioned')
```

Leo (platform): Add telemetry requirement: SDKs must emit `sdk.routing_remap` counter tagged with {lang,mode,remapped:true|false}. If both legacy and new header present emit sampled `sdk.routing_conflict` debug event. Console team will add a small "Routing policy reconciliation" tile showing mismatch rate and example traces.

Oscar T: We'll add CHANGELOG entries and a short migration note. Also include a snippet showing env var opt-in and the client builder API. Make sure tests assert precedence ordering.

Maya R: Release notes blurb: "To opt in to automatic header normalization set REDWOOD_ROUTE_POLICY_BEHAVIOR=mirror or call client.WithRoutingStrategy('balanced')." FAQ entry: "What if both headers set?" -> explicit param > X-Routing-Strategy > legacy keys.

Leo (platform): Confirmed: legacy acceptance window ends 2026-09-10. We'll surface sampled trace links for conflicts in console. Docs to be published tomorrow.

Oscar T: I'll open PRs for go-sdk + ts-sdk today with the helper, env var support, telemetry, and tests. Can we do a quick sync tomorrow 8:30 PT to review the console mock and telemetry thresholds?

Maya R: Yep. Sync tomorrow 8:30 PT in #devex. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
